claims.statement: ecshopx-espier is the platform-common-capabilities bundle (upload, address, upgrade etc.), declared in its package-info; its OperatorJwtAuthenticationFilter attribute key is imported by super-admin, shopmenu-border, comments, tdkset and one-code controllers to read the operator context that espier's own interceptor sets, and data-cube depends on it in its POM.

StorageFactory selects the storage driver from ecshopx.storage.driver (local/oss/aws/qiniu/cosv5, any other value throws BadRequestException) and caches one StorageDriver instance per driver:fileType pair in a ConcurrentHashMap, so driver config is fixed at startup; for oss/qiniu/cosv5 each of the three disks (file/image/videos) has its own bucket/endpoint/domain block while local and aws use a single bucket.

FileStorageService.buildUploadKey derives every upload object key as [projectName/]{fileType}/{companyId}/{yyyy/MM/dd}[/{group}]/{md5(yyyyMMddHHmmss)}{filename}, where projectName (ecshopx.storage.project-name, PHP-parity OSS_PROJECT_NAME) isolates tenants sharing one bucket and is omitted when blank; filename falls back to a 32-hex UUID when empty.

FileStorageService exposes two multipart validation regimes: upload()'s assertUploadMultipart rejects the file disk outright with ResourceException and otherwise only checks the MIME primary type (image/* or video/*, subtype unrestricted) plus the shared EspierUploadMessages.MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES cap (50 MiB, aligned with the Spring multipart limit) via BadRequestException, while uploadeImage()/uploadImportLocalRelativePath()'s assertEspierUploadeImageMultipart restricts subtypes to image/jpeg|jpg|png|gif and video/mp4 under the same 50 MiB cap, with the exception type chosen per caller (ResourceException vs BadRequestException); upload() always appends a literal .png extension under the local driver regardless of actual bytes, and uploadImportLocalRelativePath is local-only (BadRequestException under any non-local driver, hence dead under the shipped OSS/Qiniu/AWS/COS production drivers) and returns the bare relative key, used only by FrontWxappEspierUploadImageService.uploadeLocalImage.

getUploadToken returns a driver-specific credential envelope: local returns {domain, key}; oss fills an OSS Web-Post policy; aws returns a 3600-second presigned PUT URL; qiniu and cosv5 fill their vendor upload-token fields; under cosv5 a non-blank supplied filename must contain a non-empty extension (assertCosNonBlankFilenameHasExtensionIfNeeded), applied on both the token and direct-upload paths.

When ecshopx.storage.driver=local (or is unset), StorageWebMvcConfigurer maps the configured local root directory onto /storage/** as static resources so uploaded files are directly fetchable over HTTP; LocalStorageDriver creates its root at construction and its privateDownloadUrl is just the public URL (no signing on local disk), while LocalStoragePublicUrl prefers the configured ecshopx.storage.local.url base and falls back to a request-derived absolute /storage/... URL when it is blank.

Espier's Excel import machinery has two extension points: EspierUploadFileHandler/UploadFileService-side beans (supportedFileType, check, optional trySyncProcess, handleAfterInsertInRequestThread) registered in EspierUploadFileHandlerRegistry which fails startup on a duplicate file_type, and EspierImportRowSink — the row-level hook declared in ecshopx-common and implemented in domain bundles (goods, distribution, employee-purchase, promotions, adapay, selfservice, pointsmall) — assembled into the espierImportRowSinkByType map by EspierImportRowSinkMapConfiguration, which also fails on duplicates.

EspierUploadHandlerBeans declares the 23 built-in import types (member_info, member_update, member_consume, supplier_goods, normal_goods and its epidemic/store/profit/tag/pointsmall variants, normal_orders(_cancel), selform_registration_record, distributor_info, upload_distributor_white, pos_store_account, whitelist_create, update_distribution_item, limit_sale_item, adapay_tradedata, community_chief, employee_purchase_employees, employee_purchase_activity_items_sort, upload_tb_items) as anonymous AbstractEspierTableUploadHandler subclasses built by one delegating(...) helper that binds one EspierUploadHeaderCatalog header set to the matching EspierImportRowSink from the espierImportRowSinkByType map (IllegalStateException when a domain bundle forgot its sink); upload_tb_items is the only handler with an extra file check, rejecting non-xlsx files.

The Excel import runs as two dispatch-bus jobs on the slow Redis queue with names from EspierDispatchJobNames in ecshopx-common: job:168 UploadFileJob (EspierUploadFileJobHandler → EspierUploadFileAsyncRunner, which re-reads the workbook, builds the column map and splits rows into chunks) and job:169 ImportDataJob (ImportDataJobHandler → UploadFileImportDataService, which processes rows and merges results); both handlers are registered by bootstrap *JobRegistrationConfig classes and published by bootstrap DispatchPublisher impls.

POST /api/v1/espier/upload_file (@AdminAuth @ShopLog @Activated(espier.upload)) is the single entry point; UploadFileService.handleUploadFile is @Transactional(rollbackFor = Exception.class) and, when shouldQueue is true, publishes the UploadFileJob only via a TransactionSynchronization.afterCommit hook so a rolled-back transaction never enqueues, while the controller forces shouldQueue=false under the local Spring profile to run the import inline.

EspierUploadFileAsyncRunner chunks imported rows at 500 per ImportDataJob, pre-writes left_job_num = ceil(rows/500) on the espier_uploadefile row, and dispatches chunks with descending sort (numChunks down to 1); UploadFileImportDataService processes every row in its own REQUIRES_NEW transaction (a bad row increments errorLine and appends an aligned error row instead of aborting) and mergeFinishState spins until left_job_num equals the chunk's sort, then decrements it via an optimistic where id=? and left_job_num=? update (retrying on ResourceException), so chunks merge in descending sort order and the highest-sort chunk flips the row to finish; EspierUploadFileAsyncRunnerChunkDispatchTest pins the 501-row → two-chunk (500+1), left_job_num=2, sorts [2,1] behaviour.

EspierUploadFileAsyncRunner is idempotent-by-status: it re-reads the espier_uploadefile row and bails unless handle_status equals wait, then sets processing before parsing; empty-table, storage-read and header/parse failures each persist a finish row with a handle_message errorlog, delete the stored file, and still invoke the handler's handleAfterInsertInRequestThread.

EspierUploadFileStorageWriter always writes imported workbooks to the file disk under the deterministic relative path {file_type}/{companyId}/{uploadEpochSeconds}/{md5(fileName)}{ext}, and the same rule is exposed as buildRelativePathForImport(fileType, companyId, fileName, uploadEpochSeconds) so delete-error-file can rebuild the path from row metadata alone.

Two XXL-JOB handlers in espier follow the shared alert-and-rethrow template (log, publish CronAlertEvent, rethrow): delete-error-file → UploadFileService.scheduleDeleteErrorFile pages 100 rows at a time over espier_uploadefile rows older than 15 days whose handle_message.errorLine is non-zero and deletes the stored workbook, and delete-history-file → ExportLogService.scheduleDeleteHistoryFile removes the export/zip/<fileName> object and the export_log row for finished exports older than 3 hours.

MiddlewareWebMvcConfigurer registers the whole HTTP middleware chain on /api/** for every bundle in the single Spring context, in order: EspierAgreementRateLimitInterceptor (order 5, path-scoped to /api/v1/espier/system/agreement), AdminAuthInterceptor (order 10, /api/** minus operator login/oauth/captcha/sms/third-saascert exclusions), FrontNoAuthInterceptor (15), FrontAuthInterceptor (20), ActivatedInterceptor (100), DataPassInterceptor (200), ShopLogInterceptor (300).

AdminAuthInterceptor (triggered by @AdminAuth on method or class) skips verification when PosJwtRequestAttributes.POS_JWT_USER_DATA is already set (POS requests are pre-authenticated by PosJwtAuthenticationFilter), otherwise verifies the operator Bearer JWT with OperatorJwtCompactCodec against an HMAC key built from JWT_SECRET (base64-decoded or raw UTF-8), rejects expired tokens, enriches shop-app member tokens, runs CompanysActivationService.checkUserAuth (403 on failure) and attachOperatorIdFromSessionClaims, attaches the selected distributor for operator_type=distributor via OperatorDistributorSelectionService (defaulting distributor_id to 0), and stores the claims in the request attribute OperatorJwtAuthenticationFilter.OPERATOR_JWT_USER_DATA that all controllers read.

FrontAuthInterceptor (triggered by @FrontAuth unless the method carries @FrontNoAuth) verifies the H5 Bearer JWT, rejects disabled accounts with 403, and stores the claims plus company_id in the H5FrontAuthAttributes request attributes; the agreement rate-limit interceptor uses an IP-keyed Redis counter espier:agreement:throttle:<ip> on companysRedisTemplate with a 1-minute expiry and 429 over 30 hits.

ShopLogInterceptor writes an operator log row in afterCompletion for every non-GET request on @ShopLog-annotated handlers (company/operator/merchant ids, resolved mapping name, URI, X-Forwarded-For-aware IP); DataPassInterceptor applies sensitive-data audit for @DataPass-annotated methods by delegating to ShopOperatorDatapassApplyService, and ActivatedInterceptor delegates menu-permission/activation/shop-permission checks to ActivatedMiddlewareService for @Activated handlers.

ShopLoginAuditFilter is a OncePerRequestFilter that applies only to POST /api/v1/operator/login: it wraps the response and, on a 200 whose JSON body contains data.token, writes an operator_name=login operator-log entry with the request URI, remote IP and the serialized response, then copies the body back.

EspierAddressTreeApplicationService builds the province/city/district address tree from the address key on the espierStringRedisTemplate (logical DB ecshopx.redis.espier.database): on a cache miss or parse failure it deletes the key, rebuilds the tree via three AddressMapper queries (provinces → cities → districts), re-caches the JSON, and normalizes ids to Long while expanding 省直辖县级行政区划 (province-administered county) nodes into one node per grandchild to match the PHP shape.

Espier's upgrade flow talks to the Shopex user center: UpgradeAgreementQueryService reads espier.shopex-usercenter.base-uri plus agreement-path/docs-path/patch-path (signed with espier.shopex-usercenter.secret) and compares the remote package version against espier.platform-version using Maven ComparableVersion; UpgradeExecuteService requires a writable espier.upgrade.storage-root, downloads the signed patch through the dedicated espierShopexUsercenterUpgradeDownloadRestTemplate and unpacks the tar.gz under an ecshopx2_free_patch mark directory, with UpgradeRollbackService reversing it; the agreement endpoint is the one the order-5 rate-limit interceptor protects.

FrontWxappEspierUploadImageService enforces a per-user daily upload quota before any storage work with the membersStringRedisTemplate key uploadImageNum:<companyId>:<userId> (capped by USER_UPLOAD_IMAGE_NUM, default 10, 86400-second expiry; the counter is incremented before validation so a rejected upload still consumes one attempt); uploadImage accepts only jpg/jpeg/png extensions derived from the original filename within the 50 MiB cap, writes to the image disk with a md5(yyyyMMddHHmmss)+md5(content) object key under an Asia/Shanghai yyyy/MM/dd path (prefixed with <companyId>/ only when the H5 claims carry a truthy company_id) and returns the public URL; getPicUploadToken enforces the same quota before delegating to FileStorageService.getUploadToken, and uploadeLocalImage bypasses the quota via the local-only FileStorageService.uploadImportLocalRelativePath.

ecshopx-super-admin (package-info: platform-level announcements) has one HTTP surface — ShopNoticeController GET /api/v1/notice/list (@AdminAuth @ShopLog @Activated(super.notice.list)) over ShopNoticeListService — but owns the shared reference tables other bundles read: ShopMenu/ShopMenuRelType via ShopMenuService (product-model name ↔ menu_type id mapping all=1/b2c=2/platform=3/standard=4/in_purchase=5, collectApisFromMenus merging the space-separated shop_menu.apis field with a 1000-row cap when unrestricted, PHP-parity assertAliasNameNotConflict/checkParentMenuType), Logistics, WxappTemplate and Accounts.

ecshopx-shopmenu-border is the write-side companion to super-admin's read side: ShopMenuController (/api/v1, @AdminAuth @ShopLog) serves GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /shopmenu plus GET /shopmenu/down and POST /shopmenu/upload through border services that write super-admin's ShopMenu/ShopMenuRelType entities directly; ShopMenuCreateService.createFromBorderRequest defaults the company id to 0 (platform-owned rows), resolves menu types via ShopMenuService.menuTypeNamesToIds, validates alias/parent-type compatibility, and performs the insert + rel-type rows + outside-language upsert in one TransactionTemplate, appending an audit line to shopmenu.is-show-audit-log-path (default logs/shopmenu_is_show_hidden.log) when an import marks a menu hidden.

ecshopx-theme (package-info: decoration, templates and page configuration) is the largest supporting bundle, with nine admin controllers (PagesTemplateController /api/v1/pagestemplate, PcTemplateController /api/v1/pctemplate, PagesTemplateSetController, WebMenuController /api/v1/web-menus, WebMenuItemController, PagesAdPlaceController /api/v1/adplace/{popup,carousel} with submit/audit/withdraw, PagesSideBarController /api/v1/sidebar, OpenScreenAdController /api/v1/openscreenad, MemberCenterShareController) and seven front controllers under /api/v1/h5app mirroring them; theme's front PagesTemplateController also exposes GET /gettdk backed by tdkset's TdkGivenSaveService.

theme's enable-theme-template XXL-JOB handler (alert-and-rethrow) calls PagesTemplateServices.scheduleEnableTemplate, which selects up to 1000 pages_template rows with timer_status = 1 (newest first) whose timer_time has passed and, per row in its own TransactionTemplate, demotes all same-company/region/distributor/page siblings from status 1 to status 2 and promotes the scheduled row itself to status 1 with timer_status 2 and a stamped template_status_modify_time.

theme has two dispatch handlers: PagesTemplateSyncJobHandler fans a template edit out to distributors (all, or an explicit id list), reading the distributor set from distribution's PagesTemplateSyncDistributorQueryService and applying it via PagesTemplateStoreSyncApplyService always for the fixed wxapp page distributor_index, and CreateDistributorJobHandler seeds default templates for a newly created distributor through distribution's PagesTemplateNewDistributorFacade; NewDistributorPagesTemplatePortImpl is theme's reverse-direction port impl.

data-cube's six XXL-JOB handlers (daily-statistics, goods-daily-statistics, merchant-daily-statistic, distributor-daily-statistic, employee-purchase-daily-statistic, employee-purchase-goods-daily-statistics) all follow the alert-and-rethrow template and only enqueue: CompanyDataService.scheduleInitStatistic walks every company, inserts a zeroed company_data row for yesterday if absent and calls CompanyDataStatisticAsyncExecutor.runStatisticsAsync, which defaults to enqueueing job:163 DataCubeBundle\Jobs\StatisticJob via bootstrap's StatisticJobDispatchPublisherImpl (ASYNC/REDIS/slow queue) and only runs inline when datacube.cron.daily-statistics.sync-inline=true; StatisticJobHandler consumes the job and CompanyDataService.runStatistics recomputes member/aftersales/refunded/amount-payed/order/order-payed/gmv counters inside the Asia/Shanghai day window.

DatacubeDispatchJobNames in ecshopx-common defines the four statistics dispatch job names — job:160 DistributorDataJob, job:161 GoodsStatisticJob, job:162 MerchantStatisticJob, job:163 StatisticJob — and bootstrap's *JobRegistrationConfig classes register the corresponding handlers on the DispatchRegistry; goods-daily-statistics pages the yesterday trade window 100 rows at a time (PAGE = 100) and enqueues one batch job per page.

data-cube statistics always derive the target date from the injected companyDataStatisticsClock bean (DataCubeTimeConfig, Clock.system(Asia/Shanghai)) so tests can pin it, defaulting to yesterday; the employee-purchase variants scope the same init to active employee-purchase activities (order_class=employee_purchase, act_id=<activity>) enumerated via ActivitiesMapper.selectActiveIdsForCubeStatistic.

data-cube's PV/UV/register counters are day-scoped Redis hashes on the datacubeStringRedisTemplate (logical DB ecshopx.redis.datacube.database, default 0): the @FrontNoAuth beacon POST /api/v1/h5app/wxapp/track/viewnum → TrackViewNumService.addViewNum increments datecube_tracklog:viewnum:<companyId>|<monitorId>:page_view:<sourceId> (always), :unique_visitor:<sourceId> (only when the open id is new to the bloom filter) and :member_visitor:<sourceId> (only inside that new-visitor branch when the open id additionally resolves to a member via MemberAccountService.getWechatSimpleUser — so member_visitor counts new visitors that are members, not all member page views); before any Redis write, addViewNum silently drops the request (endpoint still returns status:true) when companyId is non-positive, monitor_id/source_id are blank or non-numeric, or the monitor/source ids are not registered Monitors/Sources rows for that company (ECX-10920, selectCount by id + companyId via MonitorsMapper/SourcesMapper), preventing the unauthenticated endpoint from enumerating ids to mint unbounded Redis keys.

UV deduplication uses UvBloomFilterService, a Lua-script bloom filter (GETBIT/SETBIT loop sized for 100 000 expected items at 1% FPR, key uv_bloom_filter:<monitorId>:<sourceId>) executed on the sharedStringRedisTemplate — so the dedup bitset lives on the shared/default Redis DB while the counts it gates live on the datacube DB; MonitorsStatsService.buildStats then reads the counters back with one HMGET (multiGet) per key over the requested day range and joins them with paid-order aggregates from NormalOrdersMapper.selectPaidAggsByMonitorSource.

DatacubeShopRoutePermissionService is data-cube's route-alias gate: with common.check-superadmin-permission=false (the default) source APIs deliberately skip the alias gate to match the PHP route registration (api.auth + activated + shoplog only), admin/empty operator_type and specific distributor paths pass, and otherwise the alias is checked against OperatorRoleMenuAliasService.listShopMenuAliases plus ShopMenuService.collectApisFromMenus with the menu version chosen by operator type (distributor=3, dealer=5, merchant=6, supplier=7, else 1); self_delivery_staff operators are whitelisted for the delivery-staff paths.

ecshopx-tdkset (package-info: TDK settings) is two admin controllers under /api/v1 with @AdminAuth @ShopLog @DingoResponse(DINGO_422): TdkGlobalSetController (GET/POST /pcdecoration/tdkglobalset, route aliases pcdecoration.tdkglobalset.info/save) for site-wide defaults and TdkGivenSetController (GET/POST /pcdecoration/tdkgivenset/{type}) for per-page-type overrides; TdkGivenSetMenuPermissionService performs the menu-alias check and TdkGivenSaveService the persistence, with theme's front controller exposing the read side as GET /api/v1/h5app/wxapp/pagestemplate/gettdk.

ecshopx-comments (package-info: comments domain) is the product/order comment domain: admin CommentsController (/api/v1, @AdminAuth @ShopLog @DingoResponse(DINGO_400)) offers POST /comment (route alias comment.create), PATCH /comment/{comment_id} (comment.update) and GET /comments, the front CommentsController under /api/v1/h5app serves the member surface, and ShopComment{Create,Update,List}Service persist to shop_comments via ShopCommentsMapper; CommentsCreateRequestGate and CommentsMenuPermissionService implement the route-alias gates.

ecshopx-wsugc (package-info: user generated content) is the community module — posts, topics, tags, badges, post comments, likes, favourites, followers, messages, per-company settings — with admin controllers under /api/v1/ugc/{post,topic,tag,badge,comment,setting/point} and front controllers under /api/v1/h5app (e.g. POST /wxapp/ugc/post/{create,delete,share,like,favorite} and no-login GET /wxapp/ugc/post/{detail,list}); like/favourite/follower and comment counters live in Redis on the sharedStringRedisTemplate, and text/media are screened through WeChat content-safety services before visibility; NormalOrderPaySuccessWsugcDispatchListener is the order-pay-success dispatch hook whose applyAfterNormalOrderPaySuccess is currently an intentional no-op placeholder.

ecshopx-im is configuration-only customer-service chat settings: MeiqiaConfigService stores JSON blobs under im:meiqia:<companyId> and im:meiqia:distributor:<companyId>:<distributorId> on the sharedStringRedisTemplate, where the store-level blob only takes effect when the company-level is_distributor_open flag is true and per-channel URL defaults are patched back in on read; EChatConfigService does the same under im:echat:<companyId>; both degrade to defaults when the blob is missing or unparsable, and the front controllers hand the same configs to clients under /api/v1/h5app.

ecshopx-form (package-info: forms and transcripts) has two admin controllers under /api/v1: TranscriptsController (POST /transcript, GET/PATCH/DELETE /transcript/{transcript_id}) over Transcripts plus TranscriptProperties (form schema as key/value rows) and UserTranscriptsController (POST/GET /usertranscript) over submitted UserTranscripts, with FormRoutePermissionService as the route-alias gate; it is the survey/form backend that the selfform_registration_record espier import type in ecshopx-selfservice feeds.

ecshopx-one-code (package-info: one item one code) has two admin controllers under /api/v1: BatchsController (POST/GET /onecode/batchs, GET/DELETE/PUT /onecode/batchs/{batch_id} and GET /onecode/wxaOneCodeStream for the WeChat mini-program code stream) and ThingsController (POST/GET/GET{id}/DELETE/PUT /onecode/things) over the Things/Batchs entities, with OneCodeBatchsWxaQrcodeService generating the wxa QR codes and OneCodeShopRoutePermissionService/OneCodeShopOperatorContextGate as the permission/context gates.

ecshopx-tb-items owns no controllers: the module contains only its package-info.java (declaring an external-goods-sync domain that may host service implementations without a v1 HTTP stub), and the actual Taobao item import behaviour lives in the upload_tb_items espier upload type — the handler registered by EspierUploadHandlerBeans (with the xlsx-only check) and the row work in goods' UploadTbItemsEspierImportRowSink → UploadTbItemsImportRowService.

ecshopx-kujiale (package-info: Kujiale domain) serves the designer-works showcase — admin KuController (/api/v1: bind-item/unbind-item/items/list) and front KuController (/api/v1/h5app) — and its two cross-bundle integrations are: KujialeDesignerWorksByItemIdPortImpl, which implements the KujialeDesignerWorksByItemIdPort declared in ecshopx-goods so goods detail can decorate itself with linked design works, and KujialeH5CitiesClient, which fetches https://qhstatic-cos.kujiale.com/openapi/cities.json with a 10 s connect/read timeout and an optional insecure-TLS RestTemplate behind ecshopx.kujiale.cities-json.insecure-tls.

ecshopx-shopex-ai's outfit generation is queue-or-direct behind shopexai.outfit.use-queue (default true): OutfitAnyoneGenerateOrchestratorService.generateOutfitQueued inserts a MemberOutfitLog row (UUID request_id as cache key), validates the model image, writes a pending status into OutfitGenerationResultCacheService (plain StringRedisTemplate SETEX, 3600-second TTL) and enqueues GENERATE_OUTFIT_JOB on the slow Redis queue via bootstrap's GenerateOutfitJobDispatchPublisherImpl (2 retries / 3 s); GenerateOutfitJobHandler then calls OutfitAnyoneGenerationService.generateOutfit and stores either the result (plus job_completed/completed_at) or an error:true marker back into the same cache key; the controller currently hardcodes companyId=1, operatorId=1, distributorId=0 and GET /status/{task_id} is an empty-200 stub.

The supporting bundles divide their Redis usage across named StringRedisTemplate beans defined in bootstrap's MultiRedisConfig, where companysRedisTemplate is @Primary: datacube counters use datacubeStringRedisTemplate (ecshopx.redis.datacube.database, default 0), the UV bloom filter and all UGC/IM blobs use sharedStringRedisTemplate (spring.data.redis.database), the agreement throttle uses companysRedisTemplate, the address tree cache uses espierStringRedisTemplate (ecshopx.redis.espier.database), the front upload-image day quota uses membersStringRedisTemplate, and the POS JWT blacklist uses prismRedisTemplate (pos_jwt_invalidate:<sha256> keys) — so the qualifier matters for where a key physically lands.

Espier's export half reads the filter blob for CSV export from the export_key:<key> entry on the sharedStringRedisTemplate (ExportCsvDataService), and ExportDataController (/api/v1/espier, @AdminAuth @ShopLog @Activated(espier.export.file.down)) returns HTTP 200 with the error semantics inside data (status_code 500, key error) when the export session key is missing rather than an HTTP error status.

EspierUploadHeaderCatalog maps each import file_type to a UploadHeaderTitle(all, isNeed, headerInfo) triple: ordered Chinese display-label → row-field-key maps with a required-column subset, plus a headerinfo/*HeaderInfo class of per-column UploadHeaderColumnInfo(maxLength, remark, required) rows that drive template download and per-cell validation; PosStoreAccountHeaderInfo (姓名/员工号/邮箱/手机号/角色/门店/状态, all required) is the contract the companys POS store-account import relies on, its parsed rows consumed by PosStoreAccountEspierImportRowSink in ecshopx-companys; forFileType additionally covers catalog-only types with no registered handler bean (discount_goods, marketing_goods, purchase_goods, employee_purchase_activity_items) used by template-download paths.

Theme's admin PagesTemplateController routes are all gated @Activated(routeAlias = "pagestemplate.*") and re-read company_id from the OPERATOR_JWT_USER_DATA request attribute set by the espier middleware (UnauthorizedException when absent); the lists endpoint additionally defaults distributor_id from the JWT claims, rewrites the default weapp_pages=index to distributor_index for distributor-scoped queries, supports an optional regionauth_id filter, and localizes responses from the country-code request header (default zh-CN).

Espier hosts the POS JWT authentication stack upstream of the MVC interceptors: PosJwtAuthenticationFilter (@Order(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE + 40), OncePerRequestFilter) engages only when the Bearer token verifies as a POS token (token_kind=pos or iss=<POS_JWT_ISSUER>, default ecshopx-pos), skipping POST /api/v1/pos/auth/login, non-Bearer requests and non-POS tokens via shouldNotFilter; when engaged it enforces PosJwtPathWhitelist (exact/prefix allowlist of POS-reachable routes with /api/v1/store/pos-accounts explicitly denied), rejects blacklisted tokens, verifies signature and exp with OperatorJwtCompactCodec against the JWT_SECRET-derived HMAC key, and calls PosJwtSessionValidatorPort.assertSessionStillValid before storing the claims under the PosJwtRequestAttributes.POS_JWT_USER_DATA request attribute — the exact attribute AdminAuthInterceptor short-circuits on.

companys' PosJwtSessionValidator implements the PosJwtSessionValidatorPort (ticket G-L9): it re-reads the PosStoreAccount row for the token's pos_store_account_id/id claim and throws UnauthorizedException when the row is missing, not enabled, or its status, distributor_id or role no longer match the JWT claims — so disabling, transferring or re-roling a POS account invalidates its outstanding tokens immediately.

PosJwtIssuer (implementing ecshopx-common's PosJwtIssuerPort) mints POS tokens at login: scalar-coerced claims plus token_kind=pos, sub, iss, a random-UUID jti and iat/nbf/exp with TTL = JWT_TTL minutes (default 120), signed HS512 with unpadded Base64URL via OperatorJwtCompactCodec.compactHs512Url to match the PHP tymon/jwt-auth shape DigiOS and standard JWT verifiers expect; invalidate(compactJwt) verifies the token and blacklists it until its own exp.

PosJwtBlacklistService (implementing PosJwtBlacklistPort) stores the SHA-256 hex of a revoked compact token under pos_jwt_invalidate:<sha256> on the prismRedisTemplate with the TTL clamped to the token's remaining lifetime, so revoked tokens are rejected by PosJwtAuthenticationFilter and disappear automatically at natural expiry.

OperatorJwtCompactCodec is espier's shared compact-JWT codec for operator and POS tokens: compactHs256 (standard Base64, HS256) for the operator/admin SPA and compactHs512Url (Base64URL, HS512) for POS, with verifyAndParse trying a raw-segment HMAC check first and falling back to the jjwt parser so both historical token shapes verify against the JWT_SECRET-derived key (base64-decoded when possible, raw UTF-8 otherwise).

The comments front endpoint is hardened (ECX-10918): the front CommentsController's parsePageSize clamps pageSize to MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 50 (the PHP Comments MAX_PAGE_SIZE), defaults to 50 when absent, and rejects non-numeric or non-positive values with BadRequestException (page_no/pageNo similarly default to 1 and reject invalid input), while ShopCommentListService.list collects the page's distinct user_ids and resolves them in one MemberAccountService.getWechatUserInfoByUserIds batch call (throwing ResourceException when a commenter cannot be resolved) instead of per-row lookups; CommentsControllerPageSizeTest pins the cap, default, pass-through and rejection behaviour.

wsugc's admin post mutations are company-scope hardened against the PHP WsugcTenantScopeGuard: PostCreateService's edit branch (ECX-10907) and PostEditService (ECX-10919) reload the Post and throw ResourceException when its company_id differs from the operator JWT's; PostDeleteService (ECX-10909) batch-loads the target ids and requires every row to exist and match before the disabled=1 update; PostVerifyService (ECX-10921) applies the same load-all-and-match check before flipping review status; PostSetBadgesService (ECX-10925) checks both the target posts and every referenced Badge against the company before rewriting PostBadge rows; the *CompanyScopeTest classes pin the cross-tenant rejections.

wsugc's topic mutations are scoped in SQL: TopicVerifyService (ECX-10874) updates with company_id = ? AND topic_id IN (...) and throws when fewer rows matched than requested, and TopicSetTopService (ECX-10872) clears and re-applies is_top/p_order only within the caller's company, refusing unknown ids; TopicVerifyServiceScopeTest/TopicSetTopServiceScopeTest pin the company-scoped wrappers.

wsugc's WeChat content-check base URI is SSRF-guarded: the per-company contentCheck_url setting feeds the msg_sec_check/media-check calls and the client_credential access-token fetch, so UgcWxContentCheckBaseUriGuard.normalizeAndRequire — invoked by UgcWxContentTextCheckService/UgcWxContentMediaCheckService at call time and by UgcSettingSaveService.requireOptional on save — rejects anything that is not exactly https://api.weixin.qq.com (no other host, user-info, path, query, fragment or non-TLS scheme) with BadRequestException.

selfservice's RegistrationActivityDataInfoService.getDataInfo (behind admin GET /selfhelp/registrationActivity/get, route alias selfhelp.registrationActivity.info) enforces tenancy by reading as not-found: when the RegistrationActivity row's company_id does not match the operator JWT's company it returns an empty result instead of an error (ECX-10916), making cross-tenant probing indistinguishable from a missing id.

ECX-10949 bounds the asynchronous Excel import: EspierUploadFileAsyncRunner reads only the first sheet via EspierUploadExcelSheetReader.readFirstSheet(bytes, MAX_IMPORT_DATA_ROWS=5000) with the header excluded from the count; exceeding 5000 data rows throws SheetRowLimitException("数据行超过上限5000") mid-stream and the runner routes it into the same finish-row + errorlog handle_message + storage delete + handleAfterInsertInRequestThread path as a header failure without dispatching any ImportDataJob chunk, while during the read POI's ZipSecureFile.setMaxEntrySize is tightened to 50 MB per decompressed entry (MAX_DECOMPRESSED_ENTRY_BYTES) and restored in a finally block.

ECX-10937 neutralizes spreadsheet-formula injection in exports: ExportCsvFileService — the shared CSV writer used by roughly 40 domain export services, writing UTF-8-BOM files to export/csv/<name>.csv on the file disk with a 3600-second private download URL — prefixes every non-empty cell whose first character is =, +, - or @ with an apostrophe so Excel/WPS treat it as text, a rule that deliberately also rewrites negative amounts such as -12.50 to '-12.50; ExportCsvFileServiceTest pins both the RFC-4180 quoting and the five formula-prefix/negative-amount cases.

ECX-10942 company-scopes wsugc topic create/edit: TopicCreateService.createOrUpdate limits the same-name duplicate query to the operator JWT's company (a foreign tenant's same-named topic no longer blocks creation and the new row is always stamped with the caller's company_id), and the edit branch reloads the target Topic and throws ResourceException("无权访问该话题") without updating when its company_id differs.

ECX-10943 company-scopes wsugc topic deletion with silent-skip semantics: TopicDeleteService.deleteTopics filters the requested topic_id list through topic_id IN (...) AND company_id = ?, physically deletes only the owned subset (TopicMultiLangDeleteService first clears the whitelisted per-locale outside language tables for those ids), and still responds 删除成功 echoing the full requested id list — foreign or missing ids are skipped rather than rejected.

ECX-10938/10944 make selfservice form detail reads tenant-safe by degrading cross-tenant probes to 'not found': FormSettingDataInfoService.getDataInfo (behind admin GET /selfhelp/formdata/{id}, alias selfhelp.form.info) and FormTemplateDataInfoService.getDataInfo (behind GET /selfhelp/formtem/{id}, alias selfhelp.template.info) return an empty list when the loaded row's company_id is null or differs from the operator JWT's company — without invoking the multi-language read services — and blank, "0", non-numeric or non-positive ids short-circuit the same way.

Selfservice form-template writes are company-scoped: FormTemplateCreateService normalizes the content/key_index JSON and writes the base FormTemplate row plus multi-language side rows in one transaction, and both the update path (select by id = ? AND company_id = ?, ResourceException on miss) and the discard/restore status flips (ECX-10901/10904: company_id in the LambdaUpdateWrapper, "数据不存在" on zero affected rows) refuse to touch another tenant's template.

Synchronous (non-queued) Excel parses keep their own stricter row caps alongside the 5000-row async cap: EspierGoodsMarketingStyleSyncSupport.parseSync rejects more than 500 data rows with the original BadRequestException("每次最多上传500个商品...请减少后再提交") message, pinned by EspierGoodsMarketingStyleSyncSupportRowLimitTest.
